lessons.title: Lesson 1: Enterprise Architecture
lessons.html:
Java EE Application Architecture

Java EE builds scalable enterprise applications using layered architecture and containers.

Core Layers:

  • Presentation: JSF, JSP, Servlets
  • Business: EJB, CDI beans
  • Persistence: JPA/Hibernate
  • Integration: JMS, JCA
// 3-Tier Architecture Example
@WebServlet("/user")
public class UserServlet extends HttpServlet {
    @Inject UserService userService;
    
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) {
        List<User> users = userService.findAll();
        req.setAttribute("users", users);
        req.getRequestDispatcher("/users.jsp").forward(req, resp);
    }
}

lessons.title: Lesson 2: EJB 4.0 Features
lessons.html:
Enterprise JavaBeans

EJBs provide transaction management, security, pooling automatically.

Session Beans:

@Stateless
public class OrderService {
    @PersistenceContext
    EntityManager em;
    
    @TransactionAttribute(TransactionAttributeType.REQUIRED)
    public void createOrder(Order order) {
        em.persist(order);
    }
}

Message-Driven Beans:

@MessageDriven(activationConfig = {
    @ActivationConfigProperty(propertyName = "destinationType", 
        propertyValue = "javax.jms.Queue")
})
public class OrderProcessor implements MessageListener {
    public void onMessage(Message message) {
        // Process order asynchronously
    }
}

lessons.title: Lesson 3: JPA Advanced Mapping
lessons.html:
JPA/Hibernate Deep Dive

Master complex entity relationships and query optimization.

Inheritance Strategies:

@Entity
@Inheritance(strategy = InheritanceType.JOINED)
public abstract class Employee {
    @Id private Long id;
    private String name;
}

@Entity
public class Developer extends Employee {
    private String language;
}

Custom Queries:

@Query("SELECT e FROM Employee e WHERE e.salary > :minSalary")
List<Employee> findHighEarners(@Param("minSalary") BigDecimal minSalary);

@Query(value = "SELECT * FROM employees WHERE dept = ?1", nativeQuery = true)
List<Employee> findByDeptNative(String dept);

lessons.title: Lesson 4: JSF 4.0 PrimeFaces
lessons.html:
Modern JSF Development

JSF + PrimeFaces = Rich enterprise UIs with minimal JavaScript.

Facelets Template:

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"
      xmlns:h="http://java.sun.com/jsf/html"
      xmlns:p="http://primefaces.org/ui">
<h:head>
    <title>#{view.viewId}</title>
</h:head>
<h:body>
    <p:dataTable value="#{userController.users}" var="user">
        <p:column headerText="Name">#{user.name}</p:column>
        <p:column headerText="Email">#{user.email}</p:column>
    </p:dataTable>
</h:body>
</html>

lessons.title: Lesson 5: CDI Dependency Injection
lessons.html:
Contexts & Dependency Injection

CDI manages beans lifecycle and dependencies automatically.

Qualifier Example:

@Qualifier
@Target({TYPE, METHOD, FIELD, PARAMETER})
@Retention(RUNTIME)
public @interface Production {}

@Production
@Stateless
public class ProductionUserService implements UserService {
    // Production database
}
@Inject @Production UserService userService;

lessons.title: Lesson 6: JAX-RS REST APIs
lessons.html:
RESTful Web Services

Build APIs consumed by React, mobile apps, microservices.

Complete REST Resource:

@Path("/api/users")
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
@Consumes(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class UserResource {
    
    @GET
    public Response getUsers() {
        return Response.ok(userService.findAll()).build();
    }
    
    @POST
    public Response createUser(User user) {
        userService.create(user);
        return Response.created(URI.create("/api/users/" + user.getId())).build();
    }
}

lessons.title: Lesson 7: JMS Messaging
lessons.html:
Enterprise Messaging

Asynchronous communication between application components.

Point-to-Point (Queue):

@Resource(mappedName = "jms/MyQueue")
Queue queue;

@Inject
JMSContext context;

public void sendOrder(Order order) {
    try (JMSContext ctx = context.createContext()) {
        ctx.createProducer().send(queue, order);
    }
}

lessons.title: Lesson 8: Security Framework
lessons.html:
Java EE Security

Role-based access control, OAuth2, JWT integration.

Security Configuration:

<security-constraint>
    <web-resource-collection>
        <web-resource-name>Admin</web-resource-name>
        <url-pattern>/admin/*</url-pattern>
    </web-resource-collection>
    <auth-constraint>
        <role-name>admin</role-name>
    </auth-constraint>
</security-constraint>

lessons.title: Lesson 9: MicroProfile Integration
lessons.html:
Microservices with Java EE

MicroProfile adds cloud-native features to Java EE.

Config & Metrics:

@Counted
@Timed
@GET
@Path("/orders/{id}")
public Order getOrder(@PathParam("id") Long id) {
    return orderService.find(id);
}

lessons.title: Lesson 10: Docker & Kubernetes
lessons.html:
Containerized Java EE

Deploy enterprise apps to cloud-native platforms.

COPY target/myapp.war $DEPLOY_DIR
ENV MP_JWT_VERIFY_PUBLICKEY_LOCATION=/path/to/key.pub
